name: v2.1.1 - Offline skill installs, safer archive
body:
# OpenSpec 2.1.1

This release smooths out a handful of rough edges. Skills now install straight from the CLI, with no Git and no network needed. Archive is more careful with your main specs, and `validate --strict` catches two problems before they reach archive. Your workflows don't change.

## How to upgrade

Update the OpenSpec CLI, then run this in each project:

```bash
openspec update
```

## Skills install from the CLI itself

- **No more Git or GitHub needed to install skills.** In 2.1.0, `openspec init` and `openspec update` cloned the skills from GitHub, so they failed without Git, behind a strict firewall, or offline. The skills now come from the CLI package you already installed, so setup works anywhere and the skills always match your CLI version.
- **`npx skills add` installs stay up to date.** If you added the OpenSpec skills to a project with `npx skills add`, `openspec update` used to skip them. It now finds them and refreshes them like any other install.
- **The continue workflow hands off to apply again.** When planning is complete, the continue skill tells you the plan is ready to review and that you can ask your agent to apply it.

## Archive is safer with your specs

- **Archive won't half-finish.** If the archive folder for a change already exists, the archive workflow now stops before it touches any main spec. Before, it could update your main specs and then fail, leaving them out of step with the archive.
- **New main specs come out formatted.** When archive creates a main spec, it puts a blank line after `## Purpose`, so the file passes Prettier and markdownlint without a reformat.
- **Retiring a capability reads wrapped lines correctly.** A requirement line that wraps onto a line starting with `<`, like `<args> are passed on to the script`, used to be read as stray HTML and block the retirement. It's now read as part of the sentence.

## Validate catches more, earlier

- **Frontmatter at the top of a delta spec is allowed.** `openspec validate --strict` no longer fails on a delta spec that starts with a YAML frontmatter block.
- **Overlong edits are flagged before archive.** When a MODIFIED requirement grows past the 500-character limit, `validate --strict` now warns you, so you can trim it while you're still working on the change.

## Upgrade advice that fits your install

- **Homebrew and Nix users get the right update command.** `openspec version --check` and `openspec update` used to tell every install to run `npm install -g`, and even offered to run it. A Homebrew install is now told to run `brew upgrade openspec`, and a Nix install is no longer told to use npm.

**Full changelog:** [v2.1.0...v2.1.1](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/compare/v2.1.0...v2.1.1)

name: v19.0.1
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Fixed GIF images failing Liquid AI judgments with HTTP 422; they are now sent as PNG ([#19757](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19757) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Anthropic strict-tool fallback now treats a Vertex org-policy rejection of `structured_outputs` (`allowedPartnerModelFeatures` / "disallowed feature structured_outputs") as a strict-tools rejection, retries once without `strict`, and pins `strictToolsDisabled` ([#19576](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19576)) ([#19655](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19655) by [@koeria](https://github.com/koeria))
- Kiro requests rejected with `Input is too long.` or `CONTENT_LENGTH_EXCEEDS_THRESHOLD` can now recover through conversation compaction ([#19723](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19723) by [@emotionbug](https://github.com/emotionbug))
- Kiro thinking off now turns reasoning off instead of running the model's default effort; models that cannot disable reasoning use their lowest effort ([#19722](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19722) by [@emotionbug](https://github.com/emotionbug))
- Kiro `/usage` shows purchased add-on credits, and an account whose plan credits are spent keeps serving while add-on credits remain ([#19724](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19724) by [@emotionbug](https://github.com/emotionbug))
- Kiro Identity Center logins in AWS GovCloud (US) now list profiles in `us-gov-west-1` and `us-gov-east-1` instead of the commercial regions, which reject GovCloud tokens ([#19726](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19726) by [@TechDufus](https://github.com/TechDufus))
- Statusless gateway errors reading `stream interrupted` now retry like `stream was interrupted` instead of ending the turn ([#19709](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19709)).

## @oh-my-pi/browser-relay

### Fixed

- The browser relay extension survives a browser whose loaded permission set predates the `downloads` permission: the service worker keeps working without download pairing instead of crashing before it ever connects ([#19659](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19659) by [@pavel-kalmykov](https://github.com/pavel-kalmykov))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added Liquid AI's `d1.2` and `d1.2-ultra` judge models; `liquid` now defaults to `d1.2` ([#19753](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19753) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Added `gemini-4-neon` to the bundled Antigravity CLI roster, with the `low`/`medium`/`high`/`xhigh` thought levels `agy` offers for it ([#19787](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19787) by [@ataberkus](https://github.com/ataberkus)).
- `Model.snapcompactShape` (`{ variant, frameSize? }`) gives a model its own snapcompact frame shape ([#19591](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19591) by [@ryanskidmore](https://github.com/ryanskidmore))

### Fixed

- Discovered Kiro models that cannot turn reasoning off now use their lowest supported effort when thinking is set to off ([#19722](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19722) by [@emotionbug](https://github.com/emotionbug))
- Kiro accepts AWS GovCloud (US) profile ARNs (`arn:aws-us-gov:codewhisperer:…`), which were previously skipped during profile listing ([#19726](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19726) by [@TechDufus](https://github.com/TechDufus))
- Google Antigravity no longer lists Gemini 4 Hydrogen's sonar monitor slot or its tiered High/XHigh SKUs as separate models; the tiered SKUs fold into the one Gemini 4 Hydrogen model ([#19795](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19795) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Gemini 4 Neon on Google Antigravity now shows as one model whose thinking level (low, medium, high, xhigh) selects the matching SKU, instead of four separate models, and is priced at $3/$15 per million tokens ($0.15 cached) instead of $0 ([#19789](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19789) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Gemini 4 Neon now collapses into one model on Gemini CLI too, and on the Gemini API and Vertex AI offers the xhigh thinking level and long outputs up to 262,144 tokens, with its $3/$15 Gemini API price

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- `/session` shows the path of the session's `local://` directory, and `/copy local` copies it, creating the directory first so it can be entered before anything was written there ([#19778](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19778) by [@farnoy](https://github.com/farnoy))
- `snapcompactShape` on `models.yml` models, `modelOverrides` and extension `registerProvider` models sets that model's snapcompact frame shape ([#19591](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19591) by [@ryanskidmore](https://github.com/ryanskidmore))

### Fixed

- Fixed PTY command transcripts sometimes gaining a blank line where a `\r\n` line ending was split across two terminal reads.
- Fixed the shell's `dirname` builtin on Windows ignoring `\` separators and drive prefixes (`dirname 'C:\a\b'` printed `.`), which broke scripts like VS Code's `code` launcher (`./Code.exe: No such file or directory`)
- Fixed bash output minimizing being skipped on Windows when a command is named by a `\` path or with `.exe` (`"C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe" status`, `git.exe log`)
- Fixed the bundled `omp://tools` docs still describing the removed `ida` tool; `tools/dsm.md` now documents eval's `dsm` namespace and `disassembler.*` settings, and `tools/read.md` documents metadata-only executable reads ([#19608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19608))
- Fixed native terminal hosts such as Tern placing extension aboveEditor widgets and a blank row between the status row and the tray; the widgets now sit above the status row ([#19767](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19767))
- Fixed `^model` mentions in queued messages (`->`/`=>` while the agent is busy, later items of a numbered list, RPC `steer`/`follow_up`, ACP steering) reaching the model as literal `^provider/model` text instead of registering their `m<N>` agent ([#19683](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19683) by [@a-glapinski](https://github.com/a-glapinski))
- Fixed `^model` mentions in extension messages sent with `sendUserMessage({ deliverAs: "steer" | "followUp" | "aside" })` while the agent is busy reaching the model as literal text ([#19799](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19799) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed every message queued behind an undelivered `^model` mention repeating the "`m<N>` now available" notice to the model ([#19799](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19799) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- A plugin manifest with a non-string `extensions` entry (e.g. an object) no longer crashes extension loading with `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE`; the entry is reported as not found and valid entries still load ([#19674](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19674) by [@koeria](https://github.com/koeria))
- Fixed embedded `bash script.sh` resolving `BASH_SOURCE[0]` to `bash` instead of the script path, which broke scripts loading files beside themselves ([#19792](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19792))
- Fixed proxy model discovery ignoring a gateway's advertised input modalities and output-token cap ([#19754](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19754) by [@zhyc9de](https://github.com/zhyc9de)).
- Fixed a provider routed through an auth gateway (`transport: pi-native` in `models.yml`) still listing models from the provider's own endpoint, sending the gateway key there; such providers now skip the provider's model discovery and keep their bundled and cached models ([#19646](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19646) by [@ray8828](https://github.com/ray8828))
- Fixed a spurious "cache miss" marker on the first turn after a compaction: compaction rewrites the prompt prefix, so that miss is expected and no longer flagged ([#19679](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19679) by [@Petyok](https://github.com/Petyok))
- Fixed `omp --resume <id>` under `--mode rpc`, `--mode rpc-ui` and `--mode acp` failing at start when the session's directory no longer exists; the session now opens where it is stored, with the launch directory as its working directory, without asking whether to move it ([#19651](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19651) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed the browser relay extension dying silently in a browser whose loaded permission set predates the `downloads` permission: it now keeps working without download pairing, and the relay reports a download tracking gap instead of a generic not-found ([#19659](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19659) by [@pavel-kalmykov](https://github.com/pavel-kalmykov))
- Sharing a session whose subagents report progress faster than the uplink drains no longer ends with "collab send backlog exceeded its limit" while a guest joins
- Fixed `/loop` iterations and `/goal` continuations firing ~800ms after a turn yields to wait on background subagents or jobs; they now wait until the run finishes ([#19781](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19781))
- Fixed Codex and OpenAI API web search ignoring the `web` role's thinking level (`openai-codex/gpt-6-luna:xhigh`); the level now reaches the request as `reasoning.effort` ([#19793](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19793))
- Fixed plan review measuring "Approve and keep context" against the pre-plan model instead of the tier chosen in the "continue with" slider, so switching to a larger-context tier now enables it ([#19660](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19660))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Fixed

- Fixed omp freezing for seconds to minutes on WSL2 while saving sessions: Linux `FileLock` now locks a sidecar file instead of binding a socket, which takes about 10 ms per call there. Older omp versions still running do not see these locks, so restart them after updating ([#19704](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19704) by [@turgaybulut](https://github.com/turgaybulut))

## @oh-my-pi/snapcompact

### Added

- `resolveShape()` uses a model's configured `snapcompactShape` in place of its model-line default; an explicit variant still wins and billing still follows the model ([#19591](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19591) by [@ryanskidmore](https://github.com/ryanskidmore))

## @oh-my-pi/omp-stats

### Added

- Added 2d and 3d range presets with hourly buckets to the stats dashboard time selector ([#19766](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19766), [#19774](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19774) by [@thekitaev](https://github.com/thekitaev)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- The native session sheet shows a `Local` report line (the session's `local://` directory) as a copyable field beside the ID and file ([#19778](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19778) by [@farnoy](https://github.com/farnoy))

### Fixed

- Fixed images from a previous session reappearing at the top-left of the screen after `/new` in herdr-app ([#19749](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19749) by [@jaredlyon](https://github.com/jaredlyon))
- Loop-stall diagnostics (`ui.loop-blocked`) no longer sample the JS thread while no TUI runs, such as in an external editor or after the session ends ([#19703](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19703) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the usage dashboard rendering exhausted or pressured usage rows without a quota bar (prepaid balances, spent quotas) as dim informational text; they now take the error or warning color their reported status calls for, and a spent quota with no measurable amount reads "exhausted" instead of "no data" ([#19764](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19764))


## What's Changed
* fix(ai): retry statusless stream interrupted errors by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19711
* fix(coding-agent): kept aboveEditor widgets off tern's tray header by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19768
* fix(coding-agent): expanded ^model mentions in queued messages by @a-glapinski in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19683

name: v1.6.0
body:
### New Features

- **GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol**: both models are available on the `openai`, `azure`, and `openai-codex` providers, and GPT-6.2 Sol is now the default model for all three. See [Providers](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.6.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/providers.md).

### Breaking Changes

- Extension components: `render()` now returns `readonly string[]`, and `Container` returns the same cached array while its children are unchanged. Extensions that modify render output in place, including `super.render()` in a `Container` subclass or an embedded component's output, must copy it first ([#9549](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9549))

### Added

- Added GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol to the `openai`, `azure`, and `openai-codex` providers. Both reject reasoning effort `none` and `minimal`, so thinking level `off` is unavailable. Azure serves them with a 1.05M context window; Codex serves GPT-6.2 Sol with 500K and GPT-6.2 Astra with 272K
- Added `qwen4-max-preview` to the Qwen Token Plan Individual providers ([#12259](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12259))
- Added `deepseek-v4.1-flash` and `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` to the Qwen Token Plan Individual providers, and per-plan key variables `QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_TEAM_API_KEY`, `QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_TEAM_CN_API_KEY`, `QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_INDIVIDUAL_API_KEY`, and `QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_INDIVIDUAL_CN_API_KEY`; the shared `QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` and `QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_CN_API_KEY` still work ([#11773](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11773))
- Added a transcript notice when OpenAI drops reasoning items from a request, such as `OpenAI dropped 2 reasoning items: prefix_mismatch (details in session)` after compaction on GPT-6.2. Like the Anthropic thinking notice, it is shown when `showCacheMissNotices` is on and only when more items are dropped than in the previous response. Both notices now name the reasons

### Changed

- Qwen Token Plan providers now use the current gateways (`token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com` international, `token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com` China), and `qwen-token-plan` and `qwen-token-plan-cn` are named "Qwen Token Plan Team" and "Qwen Token Plan Team CN". Provider IDs are unchanged, and the old `aliyuncs.com` hosts still work ([#11773](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11773))
- Updated `undici` to 8.12.4 for security advisories GHSA-mqg3-3v4r-cm32, GHSA-7xg3-fphp-28hg, GHSA-5rm8-gv32-r954, GHSA-9v6h-8rgp-m69f, GHSA-3g9m-rv3r-w5w2, and GHSA-r4pc-4jcp-7pqc ([#12200](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12200))
- The default model for the `openai`, `azure`, and `openai-codex` providers is now GPT-6.2 Sol (`gpt-6.2-sol`) instead of GPT-6.1 Sol, at the same price
- The find tool's path patterns are now relative to the search directory, like grep's `glob`: `src/*.ts` finds `src/a.ts` but no longer `pkg/src/a.ts`; use `**/src/*.ts` to match at any depth. Patterns without `/` still match file names at any depth ([#12066](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12066))
- The llama.cpp extension now connects to `http://127.0.0.1:9931` by default, the current llama-server default port, instead of port 8080 ([#12001](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/12001) by [@julien-c](https://github.com/julien-c))
- Anthropic message threads are now on by default for any provider whose baseUrl is on api.anthropic.com, not only the `anthropic` provider ([#11987](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11987))
- The resume command printed on exit is now on its own line after `To resume this session:`, so it can be selected with a triple-click ([#12237](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12237))

### Fixed

- Fixed `read` storing a note that the current model does not support images, which was replayed to the model as stale text after switching to a vision model. The image is still replaced with a placeholder per request for models without image input, and the read result now shows the warning in the TUI only, also when collapsed ([#12131](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12131))
- Fixed MCP tools loaded by `tool_search` being dropped on resume and `/reload` when an extension deactivates only its own tool at `session_start`, as pi-web-access and pi-subagents do in `toolActivation: "auto"` mode ([#11996](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11996))
- Fixed the standalone binary failing to resolve extension npm dependencies whose entry point is declared in `package.json` `main` or `exports` (for example `shiki`, `yaml`, `graceful-fs`), including imports made from inside other dependencies ([#12012](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12012))
- Fixed the find tool returning no results for patterns starting with `./`, such as `./src/*.ts` ([#12020](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12020))
- Fixed pi exiting with an uncaught `AbortError` when a `read` tool call is cancelled while the file is being opened ([#11956](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11956))
- Fixed pi exiting with an uncaught `AbortError` when the session picker cancels loading after skipping a `.jsonl` file that is not a session, and fixed such files staying open ([#11956](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11956))
- Fixed `/share` crashing pi when the GitHub CLI fails to start
- Fixed `pi update` on Windows managed installs failing with "Could not verify managed Pi" when an older system Node.js comes before the installer's standalone Node.js on PATH ([#12048](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12048))
- Fixed `/export` HTML showing raw terminal hyperlink escape codes around links in custom tool output; links are now clickable ([#12003](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12003))
- Fixed the bash tool returning no output, with a footer like `[Showing lines 3-2 of 2]`, when the output ends in one line longer than about 100KB, such as a `grep` match in a minified file; it now shows the end of that line ([#12062](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12062))
- Fixed provider errors reading "Connection closed." not triggering automatic retries ([#12064](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12064))
- Fixed `/resume` sometimes selecting an unrelated session while the list reloads after deleting or renaming a session ([#12106](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12106))
- Fixed Groq Qwen models failing with `400 Unexpected message role`; OpenAI-compatible providers other than OpenAI now receive system messages (the system prompt and mid-conversation system messages) with the `system` role ([#10741](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10741))
- Fixed `enabledModels`/`--models` warnings such as `No models match pattern "github-copilot/nope"` being written over the interactive TUI on every `/new`, `/resume` and `/fork`, which left stale lines in fullscreen mode. The warnings are now shown once at startup, in the chat in interactive mode and on stderr in other modes; RPC mode no longer repeats them on stderr for each `new_session`, `switch_session` or `fork` ([#11264](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11264))
- Fixed the find tool matching path patterns through folders above the search path: with the project in `~/src/app`, `src/**/*.ts` returned every `.ts` file in the project ([#12066](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12066))
- Fixed pi crashing with `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded` when rendering a very large edit diff, for example after editing a file with a multi-megabyte line, and again on every resume of that session ([#8036](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/8036))
- Fixed pressing Esc during a batch of tool calls leaving the calls that had not started yet without a result in the session; they now get an "Operation aborted" result ([#9986](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9986))
- Fixed an unreadable `CHANGELOG.md` (pi's own or an extension package's) printing `Warning: Could not parse changelog` over the interactive TUI; it now shows no changelog notes ([#11264](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11264))
- Fixed problems found when replacing the session with `/new`, `/resume`, `/fork` or RPC `new_session`, `switch_session` and `fork` never being shown, for example a project extension that fails to load after `/resume` into another project, or an `enabledModels` pattern that matches nothing after a settings change. Interactive mode now shows them in the chat and print, JSON and RPC modes write them to stderr; a problem already reported is not repeated. SDK hosts can call the new `AgentSessionRuntime.takeUnreportedDiagnostics()` at startup and after each replacement to get each diagnostic once
- Fixed RPC `new_session`, `switch_session`, `fork` and `clone` running extension `session_start` and `resources_discover` handlers twice for the new session. RPC clients now also receive events emitted by `session_start` handlers, such as `entry_appended` for entries they append ([#10470](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10470))
- Fixed an exception thrown by an extension's `pi.events` handler being printed with `console.error` over the interactive TUI. It is now reported like other extension errors: in the chat in interactive mode, as `extension_error` in RPC mode and as `Extension error (...)` in print mode. Errors from a handler that fails after its session was replaced are dropped ([#11264](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11264))
- Fixed `AgentSession.reload()` not emitting `session_start` to extensions when the SDK host bound them with `bindExtensions({})`, after it had already emitted `session_shutdown`. Extensions that start work in `session_start`, such as the MCP extension connecting its servers, stayed stopped after a reload
- Fixed `--mode json` dropping events emitted by extension `session_start` handlers, such as `entry_appended` for entries they append, at startup and after an extension replaces the session
- Fixed `Could not restore model <provider>/<model>. Using <fallback>` being shown only at interactive startup. Resuming or forking into a session whose model no longer exists or has no login switched to another model without notice, and print, JSON and RPC modes never showed it. It is now reported in every mode, at startup and after `/resume`, `/fork` and RPC `switch_session` or `fork`
- Fixed git and npm output, such as `Cloning into ...` or `added 12 packages`, being drawn over the interactive TUI when pi installed or refreshed packages during `/reload`, `/new`, `/resume` and `/fork`, including temporary `-e git:` and `-e npm:` packages. In interactive mode their output is now captured, and a failed install reports the end of it. Until the TUI starts, each install is announced as `Installing <source>...` on stderr instead of showing git and npm output. git and ssh can no longer prompt in interactive mode: a package that needs a typed password or passphrase fails with a hint to set up a credential helper or ssh agent, or to run `pi install <source>` once from the shell. `pi install` and `pi update` keep live output ([#11264](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11264))
- Fixed fullscreen scrolling in long sessions saturating a CPU core by re-rendering the whole transcript on every wheel event ([#9549](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9549))
- Fixed search in `/login`, `/logout`, `/scoped-models` and `/resume` keeping the highlight on the row scrolled to before typing, so Enter picked whichever entry landed there instead of the best match; a query now highlights the top match, as `/model` does ([#12245](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12245), [#12246](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/12246) by [@acmerfight](https://github.com/acmerfight))
- Fixed exiting pi, `pi config` and the `--resume` and other startup pickers dropping terminal output still queued in stdout, such as the resets that turn off mouse tracking and Kitty keyboard reporting; the shell could then print mouse and key reports as text. pi now waits up to one second for queued output before exiting or continuing ([#12133](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12133))
- Fixed moving the cursor in a search field with Left, Right, Home or End moving the highlight back to the first entry in `/login`, `/logout`, `/model`, `/scoped-models`, `/resume`, `/settings`, the per-model settings model picker and `pi config` ([#12245](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12245))
- Fixed llama.cpp decision classifiers ignoring the image input that llama.cpp reports, such as Clef with its `mmproj`; `models.classify()` now sends their images to `/v1/systemone` ([#12282](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12282))
- Fixed `kill -TSTP` from outside pi stopping it without restoring the terminal, which left mouse tracking and the Kitty keyboard protocol on at the shell prompt and turned mouse movement into garbage input. pi now suspends as with Ctrl+Z and redraws on `fg` ([#12283](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/12283) by [@haoqixu](https://github.com/haoqixu))
- Fixed changing the thinking level on the `openai-codex` provider invalidating the prompt cache on GPT-6 models ([#12269](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12269))
- Fixed unscoped syntax-highlighted text inheriting the terminal foreground and becoming unreadable on contrasting tool cards ([#11092](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11092))
- Fixed `/copy` saying "No agent messages to copy yet." after Esc during a tool call or after a provider error; it now copies the previous answer. RPC `get_last_assistant_text` skips the same messages ([#12119](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12119), [#12121](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/12121) by [@acmerfight](https://github.com/acmerfight))
- Fixed `pi.exec` reporting exit code 0 for commands ended by a signal, such as a timeout, an abort or a crash; it now reports 128 + the signal number, like a shell (143 for SIGTERM, 137 for SIGKILL) ([#12088](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12088), [#12089](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/12089) by [@acmerfight](https://github.com/acmerfight))
- Fixed GitHub Copilot Gemini and Kimi models (`gemini-4-argon`, `gemini-4-carbon`, `gemini-3.8-flash`, `kimi-k3`) ignoring the thinking level, and Copilot usage always reporting 0 reasoning tokens ([#12110](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/12110) by [@DenielC1](https://github.com/DenielC1))
- Fixed provider errors that report only a Node socket error code, such as `read ECONNRESET`, `write EPIPE`, or `connect ETIMEDOUT`, not triggering automatic retries ([#12128](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12128))
- Fixed OpenAI rejecting requests with a 400 error when a tool's schema contains a node without a `type` (such as `items: {}` or `Type.Unknown()`); such tools are now sent in non-strict mode ([#12049](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12049))
- Fixed Mistral Large 4 tool calls stalling for minutes; Mistral models no longer receive strict tools unless `compat.supportsStrictMode` is set ([#12148](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12148))
- Fixed non-strict Anthropic tool schemas not telling the model that extra arguments are forbidden ([#12067](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12067))
- Fixed GitHub Copilot models on the Responses API (GPT, Grok, MAI-Code) filling omitted optional tool arguments with empty strings or invented values ([#12286](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12286))
- Fixed the OpenAI Codex WebSocket 60-minute connection limit failing the turn when it hit mid-stream, for example during long thinking; the request is now retried on a fresh connection ([#12124](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12124))
- Fixed the `openai-codex` provider getting almost no prompt cache hits for the system prompt on GPT-6.2 models ([#12273](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12273))
- Fixed the `openai-codex` provider ignoring a model's `maxTokens`
- Fixed fullscreen Kitty images disappearing after a full redraw such as a window resize ([#12010](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12010))
- Fixed text after a multi-row inline image in Markdown drawing over the image ([#12017](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12017))
- Fixed Kitty and iTerm2 images covering overlays drawn over them ([#11584](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11584))
- Fixed Enter on a Tab path menu for an absolute path (`look at /tmp/fi`) or a slash command argument menu (`/open /tm`) submitting the prompt instead of accepting the completion ([#12309](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/12309), [#12312](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/12312) by [@acmerfight](https://github.com/acmerfight))

### Removed

- Removed the retired `deepseek-v3.2` and `deepseek-v4-flash` from the Qwen Token Plan Team providers; use `deepseek-v4-flash-0731` or `deepseek-v4.1-flash` ([#11773](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11773))

name: v0.5.9-beta.7 — VoiceStudio
body:
### Download

| Platform | Download | Signing |
|---|---|---|
| Windows x64 | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.7-win-x64.exe) | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Windows ARM64 (experimental) | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.7-win-arm64.exe) | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| macOS Apple Silicon | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.7-mac-arm64.dmg) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| macOS Intel | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.7-mac-x64.dmg) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| Linux x64 | [AppImage](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.7-linux-x64.AppImage) · [deb](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.7-linux-x64.deb) | — Linux packages are not code-signed |
| Android | [APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.7-android.apk) · [AAB](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.7-android.aab) | ✅ Signed APK (signature verified); AAB is the Play upload bundle |
| iPhone | [Unsigned IPA](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.7-ios-unsigned.ipa) | ⚠️ Unsigned: sign it with your own Apple ID to sideload; not a TestFlight build |

**Highlights**

- Windows first-run setup no longer fails building docopt, antlr4 and dora-search from source (#4268)
- Setup downloads work behind Windows system proxies such as Clash and v2rayN (#4265)
- OmniVoice speaks region-tagged languages such as pt-BR, and saved design voices generate without a speech-to-text model (#4269)
- Settings no longer shows a permanent voice gallery "HTTP 404" banner (#4260)
- A failure that keeps repeating can no longer push other diagnostic reports out of the outbox (#4277)

### Changed

- Opt-in automatic failure reports now name which part of the app failed (main process, GPU or helper process, GPU job timeout or network) instead of reporting an unknown error (#4243)
- Removed the unused retired desktop release cleanup helper and its ownership entry. (#4172) — thanks @salemalkadadi-debug!
- Removed an unused legacy update-busy helper while retaining active restart protection (#4149) — thanks @themrbeasley!
- Retired an unused legacy update toast while preserving the active Electron update controls (#4141) — thanks @themrbeasley!
- Retired the unreachable legacy shared UI and the guard tests that held it, repointing the live-behaviour guards to the renderer, and dropped 12 unused npm packages (#4095)
- Smaller install: removed unused leftover images and old helper code from the app source (#4087)
- Projects grid view stays smooth with thousands of items by drawing only the cards in view (#4079)
- Long Projects, dub project and Transcribe history lists now render only the rows on screen, so they stay fast with thousands of items (#4074)
- Idle CPU: a hidden or minimised window no longer runs polling timers or elapsed-time clocks, and they refresh once when it is shown again (#4073)
- Removed unused renderer files and 477 unused translation strings, and `locale:check` now fails on an English key no code uses (#4047)
- Removed more unused legacy shared components, utilities and API helpers from the old shared UI folder (#4045)
- Local-model folder saves no longer unload the engine when the stored folder did not change (#4043)
- Removed more unused legacy settings, gallery and engine screens from the old shared UI folder (#4042)
- Idle polling is relaxed: the backend health probe slows when steady, cloud-sync polling pauses while the window is hidden, and the Windows parent watcher polls less often (#4041)
- Removed more unused legacy dubbing screens and hooks from the old shared UI folder (#4040)
- Release notes now open with one Download table listing every desktop and phone download with its signing, followed by the Highlights (#4037)
- Removed about 25,000 lines of unused legacy interface code, two unused font packages and the always-skipped weekly evals job; the app itself is unchanged (#2603, #4032)

### Added

- Windows and Linux x64 PCs whose NVIDIA cards are all GTX 900/1000-series (compute capability 5.0 to 6.x, driver 525 or newer) now run on the GPU with a CUDA 12.6 PyTorch build, a one-time ~3 GB download on the next launch; voices, projects and models are kept (#4242)
- Settings → General can keep VoiceStudio and its running jobs alive in the tray when you close the window, instead of quitting (#4174)
- Stories can merge adjacent lines with the same speaker and compatible voice/speed settings while preserving text and inline directions — thanks [cvak on Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1497926886020354102/1566929293853073429)! (#4161)
- Added separately opted-in failure reporting through Supermetry app intake across desktop, mobile and server installs, with private metadata and consent-controlled retries (#4137)
- Dubbing exports the selected transcript as plain UTF-8 TXT, including edited text before generating a dub, with native Save As and paired phone sharing. (#4155) — thanks @shivamdhiman999111-source!
- A dub interrupted by a crash or restart now picks up from its finished segments instead of starting over (#4088)
- omnivoice-gguf now supports voice design, non-verbal tags and the decode-steps slider (#4084) — thanks @snazzybean!
- Cebuano is now a dub translation target (#4058, #4072) — thanks @onparr-24!
- Home shows a What's new link, winter pixel snow, a Christmas-week Santa, two rows of contributor portraits, and an easter egg that hides the credits until the next update after you visit three contributor profiles (#4070)
- Voice Cloning has a generation queue: takes started while one is rendering wait their turn and run one after another — thanks @ItzSudhan! (#4064)
- Audiobooks and Stories have a New project button that starts an empty draft without touching saved projects (#4055)

### Docs

- The localization contract no longer exempts the removed legacy shared i18n catalog, which pointed reviewers at a path that does not exist (#4186) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Document the enforced up-to-date merge gate while the repository cannot use GitHub merge queues (#4165)
- Track the unresolved VoxCPM2 installation report separately from GPU fallback fixes, reported by [vinhson](https://discord.com/users/1025270992882376704) (#4154)
- Track the unresolved Windows model-loading crash and distinguish merged installer repairs from released fixes (#4146) — thanks @renaldyramadani123-code!
- Installation tracking separates shipped fixes, pending repairs and unresolved report evidence (#4121)
- Document host-managed Tailscale access for Docker without sharing the host daemon socket (#4111) — thanks @MaverickKB!

### Fixed

- A failure that repeats can no longer push unrelated evidence out of the diagnostic outbox, so the reports that explain a session survive the one that keeps happening (#4277) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Model loading progress no longer briefly jumps back to 0% after reaching 100% (#4270)
- OmniVoice understands region-tagged languages such as pt-BR and Portuguese (Brazil), and saved design voices generate without a speech-to-text model (#4269) — thanks @kirussantos for the report
- First-run setup on Windows no longer fails building docopt, antlr4 and dora-search from source (#4268)
- Downloads no longer fail at setup for users behind a Windows system proxy such as Clash or v2rayN, whose default bypass list was rejected (#4265)
- Settings no longer shows a permanent "Voice gallery update rejected: HTTP 404" banner while no voice gallery is published (#4260)
- Subtitle imports skip and count overlong timestamp millisecond fields instead of truncating them (#4259) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- The built-in browser accepts bare hostnames with explicit ports in its address bar (#4258) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- Export filenames repair Windows device names containing superscript digits (#4248) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- Windows no longer occasionally loses track of the local data folder's identity while another VoiceStudio window is writing it (#4246)
- The backend reports the version its checkout declares instead of a stale installed-metadata cache, so a venv that was not re-synced after a bump can no longer make the app claim the old version (#4240) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Export history now records a bounded, control-free destination path and shows it only to loopback callers and administrator credentials, hiding it from trusted-network, PIN and anonymous principals (#4239) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- A backend-only test run now pins the same two isolation guards as the root suite, so a deferred model preload or the host's GPU inventory can no longer leak into it, and a parity test keeps the two conftests in step (#4238) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Electron's IPC trust predicate now lives in one module instead of five copies, and a registry test fails any handler that reimplements it or registers a channel outside the shared gate (#4237) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The route-authorization census now walks the telephony gateway's own app as well, so its voice, status and media-stream routes are covered by the guard that no mutating route ships without a written authorization decision (#4236) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The functional-CJK allowlist is now a path-to-reason mapping, so every exemption states why it exists, and a test reports entries whose reason is missing or whose file is gone (#4235) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Windows ROCm setup asks uv for the interpreter named in the reviewed recipe instead of repeating the version, and a test keeps the desktop constant in step with it (#4232) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- iOS picks the same plural form as Android for Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Arabic, Hindi and French counts, instead of always falling back to the one/other form (#4231) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- omnivoice-gguf refuses to clone from a reference clip without a transcript, with the remedy, instead of failing inside the binary (#4223)
- Windows setup now explains a torch c10.dll "WinError 1114" load failure, naming an outdated Visual C++ runtime when that is the cause and listing what to try otherwise (#4230)
- Trimmed speech now ends with a short fade-out instead of a sharp cut-off (#4229)
- The startup screen only says "first run can take several minutes" while the Python environment is actually being installed, and the OmniVoice engine now reports progress during cold imports, reference transcription and synthesis so slow starts are no longer killed as "sent nothing for 300s" (#4228)
- Windows ROCm setup prefers the AMD driver's newer HIP runtime, fixing an `amdhip64_7.dll` crash on dGPU + Ryzen iGPU systems, with automatic fallback to the bundled runtime (#4225) — thanks @giuseppefaro!
- Download buttons for generated audio, batch and audiobook exports now work in the Docker/web build (#4222, #4224) — thanks @msy-jc!
- Windows startup errors distinguish Smart App Control evaluation mode from an active policy block (#4213) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- Safari extension errors with WebKit top-level stack frames no longer open the repair and bug-report prompt (#4211) — thanks @karlnorling!
- Dubbing keeps API requests responsive while marking fresh speech on the watermark worker; recovered speech retains its existing mark (#4198) — thanks @swax!
- Stories and Audiobook keep saved audio with its original connection and offer an explicit availability check for older results (#4196)
- The changelog reference allowlist no longer outlives the entries it exempts: two dead exemptions were removed and a guard now reports any future ones (#4188) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- HTTP error messages no longer interpolate raw exception text: filesystem and parsing failures return fixed, actionable text, and the remaining details pass through core.scrub.scrub_text to redact secrets and home paths (#4183) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Release preparation no longer aborts when the contributors block cannot be assembled, and a missing previous release only skips that block (#4181) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The commit identity check now resolves to a definite status when a pull request moves mid-run, instead of leaving a required check pending forever (#4180) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The gallery pin check now validates a pull request with the checker from its base commit, so a PR cannot move the pin and weaken the check in one commit (#4179) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Bundled installs that cannot run database migrations now enforce one cloud-sync identity per voice, so a duplicate identity is caught locally instead of surfacing later as a sync conflict (#4176) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Phone model catalogues generate on Windows again: the hash-pinned and byte-compared contract artifacts keep LF endings in every checkout (#4175) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Restrict native file-opening actions to the primary app window while preserving trusted recorder exports and window-local controls (#4173) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Community Gallery limits mounted cards in large catalogues while retaining the current preview, keyboard focus and paging (#4169)
- Desktop failure observers retain the original consent during backend restarts and preserve normal Promise behavior. (#4209)
- CosyVoice catalogue downloads skip unused alternative model files and use the same required assets as managed installs. (#4207)
- Android keeps large manuscripts editable and recoverable, and retains reporting consent through permission prompts. (#4206) — thanks @gaino-svg!
- The closed-PR CI sweep requests cancellations incrementally, preserves partial progress and reports incomplete searches or skipped requests accurately (#4189) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Kept automatic error reports bound to original consent through delayed work and recovery, and preserved native CI verification (#4184) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Windows ROCm setup preserves working-install stamps, verifies the pinned interpreter, and reports native crash exit codes (#4182) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Windows checkouts no longer fail the CLI packaging tests: the Debian maintainer-script cases skip when the host has no POSIX shell or symlink privileges (#4178) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Phone dubbing clip/stem exports check output space on both platforms and avoid false low-space errors on iOS (#4168)
- Linux ROCm setup skips CUDA downloads and preserves its installed PyTorch stack on resume (#4167) — thanks @khryztiam!
- GPU readiness and in-process routing reflect completed self-test failures (#4166) — thanks @khryztiam!
- CLA audits keep exempt accounts visible for provenance review without reporting a missing required signature (#4164)
- Release rehearsals show measured Android APK signing, and tagged downloads require matching signature evidence (#4163)
- Manual Windows crash reports retain the faulting thread ahead of verbose status tails — thanks @renaldyramadani123-code and @freemood36-svg! (#4162)
- macOS publishing checks Gatekeeper even when Windows installers are explicitly unsigned (#4153)
- The reviewed model-install steps now require the same authenticated consumer as the rest of the model manager (#4152) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Diagnostic bundles and Electron bug reports redact share PINs and encoded credential query parameters (#4151) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Make the installed-model licence action open its terms and acknowledgement dialog — thanks [hugotriunfa18 on Discord](https://discord.com/users/1571221621316784260)! (#4147)
- Android model downloads resume through VPNs while preserving Wi-Fi policy and saved ranges (#4140) — thanks @JerryTimi!
- Stopped playback errors from incorrectly claiming that generated audio files are missing (#4138) — thanks @AAYUSH-CODER1904!
- Transcriptions can save clean plain text and timed SRT captions, with an explanation when subtitle timings are unavailable (#4135)
- Cloud sign-in now rejects a discovery document whose token or revocation endpoint is not on the issuer's own origin (#4133) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Segmented model downloads pin public destinations with bounded DNS checks across redirects, ranges and proxies, preventing private-network fallback and CDN credential leaks (#4132) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The LM Studio model probe no longer sends the stored API key in clear text to a remote host unless plaintext LAN is allowed (#4131) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- A deterministic test now fails when a new mutating API route ships without an authorization decision (#4130) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Docker deployments now require the administrator API key for the runtime log, log stream, recent errors and crash report, as the install docs already said (#4129) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- MCP tools preserve remote caller permissions across local and HTTP backends, including failed transport lookups (#4128) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- TTS and event WebSockets now enforce the same loopback/credential rule as dictation, closing a share-PIN bypass (#4126) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Imported project bundles can no longer make ffmpeg fetch remote URLs through a playlist-shaped media file (#4125) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Deleting history, rewriting dub scripts and clearing model-licence receipts now require an administrator, as the API docs already promised (#4124) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- SoniTranslate installation and start/stop now require a local administrator, like every other engine installer (#4123) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Model deletion over the API now requires administrator rights (#4122) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Crash recurrence reports recognize current Electron version fields and distinguish beta releases (#4120)
- Reclaim idle GPU models before generation when VRAM or RAM is low (#4117) — thanks @vandyahmad24!
- Model downloads reject damaged files and retry without reusing corrupt ranges, while cancellation preserves verified work (#4116)
- Reuse verified setup wheels on low-space retries and handle interrupted size probes without an uncaught error. (#4115)
- Saved and inline pronunciation choices apply consistently across speech, dubbing, batch and voice-conversion routes (#4114) — thanks @nntloc!
- Stop cancelled setup retries promptly and keep verbose runtime probes from blocking on their diagnostic output. (#4113)
- Long recordings use duration-scaled transcription limits across uploads, dubbing, child engines and MCP tools (#4112) — thanks @xabiherdz-svg!
- URL imports restore their connection guard after temporary DNS resolver changes (#4110)
- Update the optional Dagger pipeline's OpenTelemetry dependencies to fix excessive CPU use when parsing malformed trace context. (#4109)
- Optional analytics no longer delays backend readiness, and consent changes invalidate queued startup work (#4108) — thanks @cf3901646!
- Auto setup can retry PyPI failures through the regional mirror and report the actual failed host (#4107) — thanks @mrkeshi!
- Malformed model-install status responses keep the interface open and preserve the last valid download state (#4106) — thanks @ftlcustomerservice73-ui!
- Windows installer process checks skip custom PowerShell profiles, and source installs use shorter build paths to avoid MSVC linker failures (#4099)
- Restarting to install an update keeps update status available while the local engine shuts down, avoiding missing-handler errors (#4098)
- Automatic blank-renderer recovery keeps the open workspace instead of returning Stories or Audiobook to Home (#4097)
- Dubbing keeps the saved recording for cloned and designed voices with style instructions, so each segment uses the selected speaker's reference (#4093)
- Setup on Auto-detect now retries a stalled Python download (`cpython-… (download)`) once from the other source, GitHub or its mirror, instead of stalling again (#4085)
- A refused cross-site API request now names its origin and gives the exact `OMNIVOICE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` line to add, so other local apps such as AIRI can be connected (#4083)
- Setup no longer crashes with "Cannot set property code" when a runtime download or check is cancelled on Windows (#4082)
- MOSS-TTS-Nano speaks again on a fresh one-click install: the transformers 5 shim no longer breaks model loads in its pinned transformers 4 environment (#4063, #4078) — thanks @RerankerGuo, and @rockziepromax for the report!
- OmniVoice GGUF falls back to the CPU when the GPU backend crashes, for example Vulkan on a GTX 1080 (#4050, #4072) — thanks @MeinLive!
- Full dubs no longer fail when translation fills segments with free-text directions like "slow"; unsupported ones are dropped for that segment (#4054, #4072) — thanks @user555gtb!
- Audiobook MP3 exports play and download again instead of returning 404 (#4071, #4072) — thanks @dimfk001git!
- Colab: setup cells show the failing command's output, the security-floor check judges the Mako copy Python imports, and the web UI loads through the new `*.prod.r.colab.dev` proxy — thanks @hkarmoush! (#4069)
- Turning on LAN sharing no longer crashes the backend with an Internal Server Error — thanks @blutuxyz! (#4059)
- The OmniVoice GGUF engine finds its bundled runtime again in installed apps instead of reporting it missing — thanks @b84330808! (#4053)
- When the operating system times out starting the engine (`spawn ETIMEDOUT`, seen on macOS), VoiceStudio retries twice and then says to restart the computer (#4039)
- Settings → Updates lists only your channel's releases, and Beta suggests switching to Stable when a newer stable is out (#4038)
- SSML `[spell]` keeps flag, ZWJ-joined and skin-tone emoji whole instead of splitting them (#4020) — thanks @kevin9327!

### CI

- A new check keeps both phone apps' plain-HTTP exceptions limited to the local and private hosts the contract allows (#4276) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Every pinned GitHub Action is resolved against the version its comment names on a weekly run, so a swapped commit SHA surfaces instead of passing the shape checks (#4275) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The route guard now fails when a new GET route ships without an authorization decision, so a GET that starts work or reaches the network cannot slip past the mutating-route policy (#4274) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Wait for hittability before every iOS UI-test tap (#4249)
- Every GitHub Action is now pinned to the same commit across all workflows, so a security bump reaches the whole CI instead of the files the last author edited, and a test keeps it that way (#4241) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The bundled command's install smoke, which had no caller, now runs on the macOS and Linux legs of the install job with real uv, and skips instead of failing on Windows (#4234) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The install smoke now runs for the files its build actually installs, so a change to the package manifests, lockfiles, builder config or runtime setup helpers cannot break the installer unnoticed (#4233) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- CI actions gain artifact and no-push Docker contract checks, with one bounded mobile artifact-upload retry (#4192)
- CI pins the version of the security analyser it installs at run time, so a new release cannot silently change the findings (#4187) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Documentation and inventory changes run a read-only docs drift check on relevant pull requests, with rolling-issue maintenance kept in nightly/manual jobs (#4185) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Container builds grant the registry-write token only to the jobs that publish images, not to every job in the workflow (#4177) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- CI reuses unchanged iOS checks, rechecks shared diagnostic inputs and skips Nix builds for documentation and test changes. (#4208)
- Windows release and optional-engine tests use portable text fixtures, native Bash and normalized cache paths (#4197) — thanks @swax!
- Release builds load app-intake credentials from GitHub Actions Secrets without public-variable fallbacks (#4204, #4205)
- Fixed Android screenshot capture waiting behind the optional error-report prompt (#4202) — thanks @velixio!
- Keep iOS voice-search and download checks reliable across saved model choices (#4171)
- The iPhone smoke test waits for typed text to reach the editor instead of reading it once, removing a CI flake (#4100)
- MOSS compatibility tests keep checking the active Transformers version after another test restores imported modules (#4096)
- The iPhone UI smoke test keeps its slow-inventory case loading for the whole test, so a slow simulator no longer fails it (#4076)
- Docker's web build no longer fails the unused-key check when only `electron/` is copied, and the iPhone CI job allows for a native-runtime cache miss (#4052)
- Removed unused scripts, the old Tauri MSI tooling and leftover Turborepo ignore lines (#4046)
- Accessibility smoke timeouts now name the requests still pending, so a flaky CI failure points at its cause (#4036)

### Bug reporters

- @jailbird147 — Windows setup failing to build source-only packages (#4253)
- @Wahap404 — setup downloads failing behind a system proxy (#4262)
- @baoyu0 — the voice gallery 404 banner (#4251)
- @kirussantos — region-tagged OmniVoice languages (#4269)
- @gaino-svg — long Android manuscripts (#4201)
- @renaldyramadani123-code and @freemood36-svg — native-crash evidence that improved manual reports; the underlying Windows crash remains unresolved (#4142, #4158, #4162)
- @rockziepromax — MOSS-TTS-Nano voice cloning (#4063)
- @MeinLive — GGUF GPU crashes and the relocated runtime lookup (#4050, #4051)
- @user555gtb — directions that interrupted full dubs (#4054)
- @dimfk001git — audiobook MP3 playback and downloads (#4071)
- [hugotriunfa18 on Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1571229026138325102/1571229026138325102) — the installed-model licence action (#4143)
- [vinhson on Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1567177140007608350/1567177140007608350) — VoxCPM2 installation evidence retained in the tracker; this report remains unresolved (#4154)

### Contributors

New since v0.5.9-beta.6: @debpalash, @DeryFerd, @isnaenihidayat, @b84330808, @RerankerGuo

Everyone who contributed since v0.5.8: @debpalash, @DeryFerd, @velixio, @ItzSudhan, @swax, @isnaenihidayat, @b84330808, @blutuxyz, @RerankerGuo, @karlnorling, @kevin9327, @x3vyx, @hkarmoush, @salemalkadadi-debug, @vandyahmad24

body:
## 2026.11.10-beta.1

### Highlights

- Agent templates: add agents directly from ClawHub packages, with a single CLAW.md manifest and bundled skill folders checked by the native trust flow. (#195707, #196322, #196348) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
- OpenClaw ID: connect nodes through the ID tunnel, approve them from Access, and link owner devices to your own identity. (#193982, #194007, #197628) Thanks @jalehman.
- Browser handoff: take over the agent’s browser directly from the Browser panel without stopping the agent. (#197928) Related #197902 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
- Chat control: send pending steering messages without stopping a run, edit queued messages, and retain composer drafts across app restarts. (#193665, #197846, #197908) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc and @obviyus.
- Updates: configure automatic update schedules and let the incoming release run its own pre-update rehearsal. (#193713, #197922) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @fuller-stack-dev.
- State upgrades: migrate Gateway state using copy-and-swap at startup rather than modifying the live store in place. (#198389) Thanks @obviyus.
- Durable execution: keep background commands running across Gateway restarts on macOS. (#197474) Related #197443 Thanks @daniel-lxs.

### Changes

- Access: add a guest member role with sandboxed session tools. (#197748) Thanks @jalehman.
- Tool discovery: offer an opt-in usage-ranked tool index, including MCP tools. (#197128, #198348) Thanks @jalehman.
- Knowledge: find current records when searches use wording from their superseded versions. (#193742) Related #193054 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
- Voice and images: choose the speech-to-text model in Settings → Talk, and let agents review generated images before delivery. (#197906, #198227) Related #197859 Thanks @daniel-lxs and @vincentkoc.
- Providers: support Parallel Decisions both natively and through OpenRouter. (#194537) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Backups: show stage and byte progress during long-running backups. (#198675) Thanks @vincentkoc.

### Fixes

- Access boundaries: apply OpenClaw ID member permissions consistently to HTTP history and connected-app panels. (#199946, #200070) Thanks @joshavant.
- Queued input: show a visible withheld failure when permission is revoked instead of silently canceling the message. (#200213) Thanks @vincentkoc, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @obviyus.
- Subagents: retain results through Gateway restarts and retry completion delivery after the requester is interrupted. (#199868, #200165) Authored by @steipete.
- OpenAI responses: recover item conflicts across runs and complete replay-safe turns after deferred conflict recovery. (#199896, #200254) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT and @obviyus.
- Slack delivery: preserve the final reply when native streams hit a boundary or message-length limit, and keep expired progress from appearing after the answer. (#199849, #200080) Related #200045 Thanks @n1hility, @obviyus, and @atlas-kring.
- Discord: render edited messages consistently with new sends while preserving literal user-mention tokens inside code. (#199958, #200053) Related #190479, #195585 Thanks @obviyus, @yetval, and @saariuslystoned.
- Signal: preserve native mention recipients in quoted messages. (#200058) Related #195074 Thanks @obviyus and @saariuslystoned.
- Chat history: preserve reading position when transcript ranges shrink, load older history after interrupted restoration, and retain pasted text if the clipboard changes mid-paste. (#199747, #200107, #200098) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc and @obviyus.
- Usage display: stop presenting fully unpriced usage as a known zero-dollar cost. (#199711) Related #199710 Thanks @JoshSalomon and @obviyus.
- Update recovery: restrict startup copies and pruning to owned state and preserve successful startup writes for the next Doctor run. (#199929, #200260) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Responsiveness: reduce cold-session compaction CPU and latency regressions, prepare large histories outside the Gateway thread, and shorten write locks during large Knowledge vault scans. (#199561, #200114, #199859) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @jalehman.

### Complete contribution record

The full contribution record is available in the tag-pinned [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.10-beta.1/CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.10-beta.1.md#complete-contribution-record).

name: CC Switch v4.0.36
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.36

本版本新增**插件**页面，可以在 CC Switch 里安装、启用、更新、卸载 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build、MiniMax Code、OpenClaw、Pi 的插件，并管理 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 的插件市场。技能仓库现在可以用**访问令牌读取私有仓库**；经本地路由的供应商可以设置**费用倍率**；会话管理里能看到 Claude Code 桌面版的**章节**。

另外修复了 Codex 开了官方额度保护后自动审批也被拦下；Codex 聚合模式下新发布的官方模型要很久才出现；OpenCode 升级到 2.x 后 1.x 会话的用量不再统计；用量页自定义日期一输入年份就变成 1905；Antigravity 多个模型显示未定价等问题。用量统计里价格相同的推理档位现在合并成一行。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.36-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.36-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### 插件页面

侧栏新增「插件」，通过各应用自己的命令行管理插件（需求见 [#791](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/791)，[#9220](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9220)）：

- 支持 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build、MiniMax Code、OpenClaw、Pi，只列出没有隐藏的应用。
- 「已安装」里可以启用、停用、更新（MiniMax Code 不能更新）、卸载；「发现」里搜索并安装；Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 还可以在「市场」里添加、刷新、移除插件市场，地址可以是 GitHub 的 `owner/repo`、Git 地址或本地文件夹。Pi 的插件来自 npm 上的 Pi 包。
- Grok Build、OpenClaw、Pi 安装前会先确认：插件以你的权限运行，只装来源可信的。Claude Code 里要在终端同意的插件，CC Switch 不替你同意，会提示到终端运行对应的安装命令；需要先登录的应用也会提示登录命令。
- Codex 停用插件只改 `config.toml` 里这个插件的 `enabled`，其余内容和注释不动。
- 大的市场仓库下载可能要几分钟，可以先关掉对话框，完成后会提示。

### 技能仓库支持私有仓库

「管理技能仓库」里可以按站点设置访问令牌，GitHub、GitLab、Gitea / Forgejo 上的私有仓库都能浏览、安装和检查更新（需求见 [#9666](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9666)）。

- 令牌按站点保存（如 `github.com`、`gitlab.example.com`），存在系统的凭据存储里（macOS 钥匙串、Windows 凭据管理器，其他系统是本机仅自己可读的文件），不随云同步。只需要只读权限。
- 下载失败时会区分是没设令牌，还是令牌被拒（无效、过期或无权读取这个仓库）。

### 供应商费用倍率

中转按折扣计费时，用量统计里的花费可以按倍率估算（[#9656](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9656)）。Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok Build 的非官方供应商表单里新增「供应商费用倍率」：这家所有模型的参考价都乘以它，0.5 即半价，留空为 1 倍。

- 只对经本地路由、并且设置之后的请求生效；直连时从会话记录导入的用量仍按 1 倍统计。

### 会话管理里显示 Claude Code 桌面版的章节

Claude Code 桌面版里模型给对话打的章节，以前显示成普通的 MCP 工具调用（需求见 [#9728](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9728)，[#9729](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9729)）。现在显示成章节行，收起时间线也能看到；对话目录里会列出章节，点击即跳转；查找能搜到章节，导出 Markdown 时章节变成标题。

---

## 变更

- **用量统计合并价格相同的推理档位**（[#8845](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8845)，见 [#9065](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9065)）：同一个模型的不同推理强度，如果输入、输出、缓存读、缓存写四种价格都和基础模型相同，并且基础模型有精确价格，就合并到基础模型那一行。筛选、每日汇总和首字时间都按合并后统计，请求日志里仍显示原始模型名。

---

## 修复

- **Codex 开了「官方额度保护」后，达到阈值时自动审批也被拦下**（[#9733](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9733)，见 [#9732](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9732)）：OpenAI 已经让 Codex 的自动审批模型 `codex-auto-review` 免费、不计入套餐额度，现在额度保护对它直接放行，其他官方模型照常暂停。
- **Codex 聚合模式下，新发布的官方模型（如 GPT-6.2）要很久才出现**：聚合模式下 Codex 只读 CC Switch 写的模型目录。官方模型列表的缓存从 6 小时缩短到 1 小时；获取列表时报的 Codex 版本也会参考桌面版自带的 CLI 和 Codex 自己记录的版本，桌面版自动更新后不会再按旧版本拿到少一截的列表。
- **OpenCode 升级到 2.x 后，之后在 1.x 里新建或继续的会话不计入用量**（[#8363](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8363)，见 [#8361](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8361)）：新旧两套数据并存时现在两套都读，同一条消息只算一次。以前扫描过的数据库从上次扫描处继续，不回补更早的记录。
- **用量页自定义日期手动输入年份时，一输入就变成 1905**（见 [#9699](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9699)）：现在输入完整的日期才生效，输入过程中不会被改写。
- **Antigravity 多个模型在用量统计里显示「未定价」**：Gemini Flash 的 tiered 版本（如内置浏览器子代理用的 `gemini-3.8-flash-tiered`）按 Flash 基础价计费（[#9600](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9600)）；Hydrogen 的 tiered 版本按基础价计费（[#9706](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9706)，见 [#9705](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9705)）；用 Orchestrator 时的执行步归到 Gemini 4 Hydrogen（[#9686](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9686)，见 [#9685](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9685)），规划步归到 Gemini 4 Neon 并新增它的价格（[#8845](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8845)）；Claude 的 Thinking 版本（如 Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking)）按对应的基础模型计费。已有的未定价记录会自动补算。
- **Claude Desktop 路由模式下模型列表留空，用的是默认的 Claude 模型名而不是供应商的模型**（见 [#9735](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9735)）：路由模式本来如此，表单提示现在写清楚了：直连时留空会自动读取 `/v1/models`，路由模式下要用供应商的模型请填写模型列表。
- **DeepSeek Harness 的 home 级 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 MCP 在 CC Switch 里看不到，也没有说明**（见 [#9714](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9714)）：CC Switch 只读写各 profile 的文件，MCP 导入对话框现在写明 home 级文件既不读也不写，其中的 MCP 请在那里管理。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @funkpopo、@allenxu09（插件页面）、@DemosHume（供应商费用倍率）、@leecobaby（会话章节）、@jantodec（额度保护放行自动审批）、@OrrHsiao（OpenCode 新旧数据库并存时的用量）、@dsdbb520（合并同价推理档位、Gemini 4 Neon 价格）、@jimpablo（Gemini Flash tiered 计价、Orchestrator 执行步归属）、@ziyangxiami（Hydrogen tiered 计价）的贡献。

特别感谢以下贡献者：你们的 PR 发现并修复了真实的问题，只是同样的问题后来在主线上另行修好，PR 因此关闭。@wc7086（[#8743](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8743)，私有 GitHub 技能仓库匿名下载一律 404，本版访问令牌的下载方式沿用了它的做法）、@jimpablo（[#9739](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9739)，Antigravity Orchestrator 规划步显示内部代号、未定价）。

感谢 @wqh17101、@fengzai6、@chencyan364、@I-have-an-intellectual-disability、@demo2099、@CelianNew 提出需求、报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: Sort and nginx fix - v2.8.12
body:
> [!WARNING]
> Docker images now ship nginx 1.31.9, which fixes the ten nginx CVEs published on Nov 18, 2026 (including CVE-2026-123007) affecting all versions up to and including **v2.8.11**.

> These are not BentoPDF CVEs. They are in nginx, the web server inside our Docker image, and the default BentoPDF setup does not use any of the affected features (HTTP/2, HTTP/3, TLS, mail, stream, proxying).
> However, anyone whose setup matches the conditions described in those CVEs is at risk, for example if you changed the nginx config inside the container. So I decided it was better to ship a release with the fixed nginx than to leave it.
> **All users are strongly advised to upgrade to v2.8.12 immediately.**


## New

- Sort your file lists by name, modified date or size, ascending or descending. Works in Merge PDF, Alternate Merge, and the image and text to PDF tools.
- Top bar buttons now show hover text when their labels are hidden. Thanks @AB527.

## Fixes

- Validate Signature now detects and verifies document timestamps, and flags weak ones. Thanks @AB527.
- Workflows: pages with JPEG2000 images no longer render blank, and the Remove Blank Pages node works again.
- Polish is now detected correctly as a language. Thanks @atpanos for their first contribution.


To update: `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf/compare/v2.8.11...v2.8.12


## New Contributors
* @atpanos made their first contribution in https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf/pull/982 ❤️

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf/compare/v2.8.11...v2.8.12

name: v2.14.25 — Community batch: fourteen new tool guides, three guide updates, and three skill contribu…
body:
Community batch: fourteen new tool guides, three guide updates, and three skill contributions.

- **New integration guides**, each reviewed against the usefulness and neutrality rules in `tools/PARTNERS.md`: Hermoso (#1014), Calven (#980), PostOnce (#979), GetYouTubeTranscript (#975), Hyper Elements (#974), ScrapeWhale (#972), Adspy (#965), Adeli (#964), SignalShelf (#959), GoAnyAPI with a CLI and tests (#946), Parallel with a CLI and tests (#943), Marcora (#939), Adlicio (#898), and SocialToAI (#917). Updated guides: Precleared (#957) and Coupler (#904). Edits made on the way in: tracking links, in-guide disclosure lines, pointers to vendors' own skill packs, comparison framing, and price pitches were removed; Adlicio no longer documents Google Maps or logged-in Facebook group scraping; GetYouTubeTranscript and ScrapeWhale carry a platform-terms note.
- **social** (2.5.4 → 2.6.0): a new `references/chinese-platforms.md` on Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, Bilibili, and WeChat (how search works, what the metrics mean, creator and ad marketplaces, disclosure rules, data limits), and a Social Data & Listening category in the registry (#917 by the SocialToAI team; the reference names no tool).
- **Outdated facts corrected** (#892 by @canermoral5-sys), after a check against primary sources. **ai-seo** (2.12.6 → 2.12.7): the GEO study table now carries the figures derived from the paper's Table 1 (quotations +41%, statistics +31%, fluency +28%, citing sources +27%, keyword stuffing -8%), with the rank effect (citing sources helped a fifth-ranked site and hurt the top one); Search Console's Generative AI performance report replaces "no AI-specific reporting"; Claude's use of Brave is described as reported, not documented. **ads** (2.7.8 → 2.7.9): Meta's 20% text limit is gone since September 2020, and the event-prioritization checklist items are replaced. **seo-audit** (2.2.8 → 2.2.9): a caveat on Search Console impressions between May 13, 2025 and April 27, 2026. **prospecting** (1.6.2 → 1.6.3), **cold-email** (2.2.6 → 2.2.7): Austria joins Germany and Italy in requiring prior consent for cold email. **emails** (2.1.8 → 2.1.9): open rate is a trend within one list, not a benchmark. **paywalls** (2.1.4 → 2.1.5): the escape hatch wording covers paid-only products. One of the PR's corrections, on ChatGPT's search providers, was not confirmed and is not included.
- **ai-seo**: the agent-readiness reference gains checks for stores: machine-readable price and availability, whether cart and checkout answer an agent's user agent, and structured returns and shipping terms (#859 by @vlloic).
- **public-relations** (1.3.0 → 1.3.1), **referrals** (2.2.6 → 2.2.7): two tool mentions that makers added to skill files in 2.14.24 are removed, under the rule that a maker's PR does not add its own tool to a skill. Both tools keep their guides and registry rows.

name: v2.14.24 — Community batch: thirteen skill contributions, rebased onto this week's changes.
body:
Community batch: thirteen skill contributions, rebased onto this week's changes.

- **public-relations** (1.2.4 → 1.3.0): a new `references/press-releases.md` on when a release is worth it, how to structure and write one, and distribution options from your own newsroom page to the paid wires, with what wire distribution does and doesn't get you (#885 by @dylancaponi, who discloses building one of the listed options). Adds a Press Release Distribution category to the registry and an eval.
- **reverse-engineer-marketing** (1.1.4 → 1.2.0): a scorecard, a page-family table, a strongest-links table, a "what won't transfer" section for advantages that aren't plays, and a cost range quoted before the first paid data call (#973 by @nilesh271080-hash; closes #966, #967, #968, #969, #970).
- **prospecting** (1.6.1 → 1.6.2), **cold-email** (2.2.5 → 2.2.6): Italy joins Germany in requiring prior consent for cold email, B2B included, and cold-email now points EU and UK sends to the country rules first (#928 by @rahul05ranjan; closes #855). The cold-email framework examples use bracketed proof slots in place of invented customers and results (#911 by @true-souljah).
- **ads** (2.7.7 → 2.7.8), **launch** (2.2.3 → 2.2.4), **marketing-plan** (1.2.5 → 1.2.6), **referrals** (2.2.5 → 2.2.6): broken links, wrong idea numbers, and a self-contradicting launch gate are fixed (#963 by @dajiaohuang; closes #948). marketing-plan now publishes a plan only to a verified private repository with explicit client authorization, with four evals (#889 by @monsterlag). referrals lists LinkJolt, with a guide contributed by its maker (#888 by @Efesop).
- **video** (2.4.6 → 2.4.7), **ad-creative** (2.13.4 → 2.13.5): one layout per aspect ratio for code-rendered video, and a frame check for cropped products, logos, and text, with product-photo guidance in the Hyperframes guide (#915 by @alexandrosmimilidis).

name: v2.14.23 — Community batch: 22 CLI fixes and three CI checks. No skill content changes.
body:
Community batch: 22 CLI fixes and three CI checks. No skill content changes.

- **CLI fixes** (by @rudycelekli, each with a contract test): **ahrefs** sends the required Keywords Explorer and SERP Overview parameters (#864); **google-ads** strips hyphens from the customer ID (#877); **similarweb** requests geography from the v4 endpoint (#876); **dataforseo** enforces per-task keyword limits (#873); **mixpanel** requires the funnel date range (#871); **supermetrics** rejects row limits that would be truncated (#879); **tiktok-ads** sends `operation_status` for campaign status updates (#872); **resend** pages audience, contact, and webhook lists with cursors (#874); **postmark** enforces batch and suppression limits (#867); **activecampaign** sends deal search as `filters[search]` and requires whole-cent deal values (#861, #862); **close** filters activities with `_type` (#860); **apollo** enforces the ten-person bulk enrichment limit (#868); **hunter** reads and pauses sequences through documented routes (#869); **lemlist** requests campaign stats from the v2 route (#870); **truelist** enforces the three-address inline limit (#863); **optimizely** changes experiment state with the documented action parameter (#866); **livestorm** creates webhooks with the documented attributes (#865); **trustpilot** pages business search with `perpage` (#875); **wistia** honors an explicit false public flag (#878); **paddle** rejects incomplete recurring price options (#858). The remaining CLIs now exit non-zero on HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses (#852).
- **Hidden-content check** (#956 by @TanmayShah29, closes #931): a new CI job and `scripts/check-hidden-content.mjs` flag content a reviewer would not see in rendered markdown: HTML comments, invisible Unicode, long blank runs, piped-to-shell downloads, and webhook or secret-exfiltration patterns. Legitimate hits go in an allowlist.
- **Validator fix** (#977 by @divya0795): `validate-skills-official.sh` reported every skill as valid, because it matched "valid" inside "Validation failed". It now fails on a rejected skill, with a regression test.
- **Trigger eval** (#978 by @divya0795): a run that ends in an error result (not logged in, API or rate-limit error) is scored as an error, not as an answer.

name: v2.14.22 — AI video and voice model facts refreshed against vendor pages, checked 2026-11-19 (#994)…
body:
AI video and voice model facts refreshed against vendor pages, checked 2026-11-19 (#994). Same treatment as the image models in 2.14.21: each tool is described by what its vendor states and where to check, with no ratings.

- **video** (2.4.5 → 2.4.6): the model comparison table and "Quick picks" are rewritten. Veo 3.1 makes 4, 6, or 8 second clips, not "variable" length, so the skill now says to plan a video as several shots. Kling is 4.0 (3 to 30 seconds), Seedance is 2.5, Hailuo runs MiniMax H3, Pika is 2.5, and the open-weight option is Wan 2.2, with HunyuanVideo's licence limits noted. Runway's row covers Gen-4.5 and its API, which also hosts Veo, Kling, and Seedance. HeyGen's plan table matched no current plan and is replaced (credits per month, 1 to 60 minute videos); its avatar and language counts and custom-avatar footage rules are updated, and its MCP endpoint is given. Synthesia's line now says what its site states. `references/ai-video-prompting.md` drops "up to 2 minutes" for Kling and other dated tips.
- **ad-creative** (2.13.3 → 2.13.4): the video and voice sections of `references/generative-tools.md`. Removed or corrected: Veo "up to 60 seconds" and its Gemini API preview models (shut down 22 Oct 2026); Kling "up to 3 minutes"; Seedance "12 reference files" and "OpenAI-compatible" (not found in its docs); Higgsfield "50+ camera movements"; per-second prices that could not be traced to a vendor. Voice: OpenAI's TTS models shut down on 6 Jan 2027 and OpenAI does offer custom voices; Cartesia's current model is `sonic-3.6` with 44 languages and voice cloning, and no "40ms" figure is published; ElevenLabs states 90+ languages on v4 and meters in credits; Voicebox's local port, engines, and languages are corrected; PlayHT is removed because its site no longer resolves. The "Best / Good" quality column in the voice comparison is gone.
- Limits: Kling's own developer docs and BytePlus's Seedance pages did not load, so their clip lengths come from Runway's listing of those models and are labelled that way. Google's Veo prices and OpenAI's TTS prices were not readable, so none are quoted; the one remaining video cost estimate names its source.

## Skill ZIP assets
