name: v2.14.17 — marketing-loops (1.8.4 → 1.9.0): a new reply-fed expansion loop in the Outbound group, 6…
body:
- **marketing-loops** (1.8.4 → 1.9.0): a new **reply-fed expansion loop** in the Outbound group, 61 loops in all (#997). Monthly, once about 30 positive replies have built up, it enriches the repliers, sets each trait's share of positive replies against its share of sends, groups the over-represented traits into two to four micro-segments, sources lookalike accounts for each, and stages the new segments for approval. It stops when there are too few replies or no trait stands out, never re-adds anyone who opted out or got a breakup email, and tags expansion segments so the sequence-retro loop reports them separately. The outbound operator's schedule lists it. Eval 10 added. Adapted from Julien Lieben's autoresearch loop playbook (ColdIQ).

name: v2.14.14 — link-building (1.0.4 → 1.1.0): two changes (#992). Paid links are handled by disclosure…
body:
- **link-building** (1.0.4 → 1.1.0): two changes (#992). **Paid links are handled by disclosure instead of refusal.** The skill still quotes Google's spam policy: a paid link that passes ranking credit is link spam, and paid links are inside the policy with `rel="sponsored"` or `rel="nofollow"`. It now states that rule and the likely outcomes once (Google ignores the link, or issues a manual action for a large or obvious pattern), leaves the decision to the user, and gives seven per-site checks for buying carefully in `references/risk-policy.md`. Rented links, sitewide packages, and exact-match anchors are flagged as higher risk. Private blog networks and automated link creation stay off-limits. **The tools table gives every tool one clause on what it is and one on when to reach for it**, the same shape for paid and free tools, and adds self-serve placement marketplaces (Serpzilla, Collaborator, WhitePress, Adsy) next to the managed service. The description gains "where to buy placements" and "link marketplaces", and its operative rule changes to match. Eval 2 updated; eval 6 added.
- **Tool awareness eval**: `scripts/tool-awareness-eval.mjs` and `evals/tool-awareness/` test how a skill's wording about a tool changes answers: whether the tool is named when it fits, how many alternatives sit beside it, whether the risk is stated, and whether it is pushed when it doesn't fit. On link-building, one clause per tool took a marketplace from never named to named in 12 of 12 relevant replies, with 3.75 alternatives beside it on average. A vendor-written paragraph was named as often but came first in 92% of replies with 1.67 alternatives. Neither was named on prompts where it didn't fit.

name: Sub2API 0.2.24
body:
> AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

安全修复：网关拒绝含重复字段的请求，修复利用重复字段使计费模型与实际调用模型不一致的问题；同时修复 Codex 文献检索返回 403 时 OpenAI OAuth 账号被批量停调的问题。

## 新增功能

- 网页搜索模拟新增 Exa 搜索服务商，web_search 结果块返回搜索来源
- Claude Code 上下文压缩请求按 5 分钟缓存 TTL 写入
- Claude OAuth / Setup Token 账号显示窗口费用估算
- 模型广场支持一键复制模型 ID
- 频繁手动刷新 Token 时给出风险提示

## 优化改进

- 网关请求体只解析一次，并减少工具 schema 清洗、命名空间剥离、图片意图识别、cache_control 检查中的重复遍历与拷贝，降低大请求的 CPU 与内存占用
- 调度器账号缓存不再保存展开后的分组信息
- 运维面板模型平均 Tokens/秒改为按累计请求耗时计算
- 网关在读取请求体阶段返回的错误（如 413）改为按各协议入口的格式返回，文案与 handler 一致
- Codex Messages 桥接把 ToolSearch 映射为原生 tool_search
- 合成路由改写到 Claude 5.5 模型时自动适配 thinking 参数

## Bug 修复

- 安全修复：请求体（含嵌套字段）及 WebSocket 帧中同名字段重复声明时直接拒绝，修复按低价模型计费、实际调用高价模型，以及绕过账号模型映射、强制 service_tier、推理强度上限的问题（GHSA-p3r4-jcm3-2hph）
- 修复带 BOM 或 Content-Type 标为 multipart 的请求体可绕过分组模型白名单的问题
- 修复 Codex 文献检索返回 403 时逐个暂停甚至永久禁用 OpenAI OAuth 账号的问题
- 修复 embeddings、alpha search、systemone 等纯文本接口的请求体上限未提前生效的问题
- 修复 Antigravity 单个请求的裸 429 冷却多个账号的问题，额度查询改用账号转发端点，并保留上游 Gemini SSE 注释帧
- 修复 OpenAI 上游请求超时不切换账号的问题
- 修复 OpenAI OAuth 令牌轮换后凭据可能因补全超时或并发被覆盖的问题
- 修复 ChatGPT OAuth 账号（含透传）调度到非 OpenAI 模型的问题
- 修复 Grok 搜索按 xAI 返回的成功次数计费，Grok 图片编辑支持 5 张输入图并保留校验错误信息
- 修复转发图片的 usage 被拆成多行 SSE、缓冲输出为空时 Responses 结果缺失的问题
- 修复协议转换中丢失 stop 序列与 Kimi 工具定义、DeepSeek Anthropic 工具续接缺少 thinking 块、Gemini 最后一轮工具结果混入多余内容的问题
- 修复 Codex 音频输入能力、VS Code IDE 上下文在 HTTP Responses 中丢失的问题，按轮次记录 Responses 推理强度
- 修复 TypeSafe System One 未应用账号模型映射的问题
- 修复 Anthropic 长上下文模型元数据未展示、账号测试对不支持 temperature 的模型仍发送该参数的问题
- 修复 Claude 与 Gemini 账号用量快照不刷新、批量透传编辑丢失模型过滤、后台创建用户未初始化默认平台限额的问题

## 破坏性变更

- 请求体或 WebSocket 帧中同名字段重复声明（包括取值相同、仅大小写不同、嵌套字段重复）时返回 400 或关闭连接；multipart 表单中 model、n、size 等字段重复同样拒绝。正常 SDK 和客户端不受影响



---

## 📥 Installation

**Docker:**
```bash
# Docker Hub
docker pull weishaw/sub2api:0.2.24

# GitHub Container Registry
docker pull ghcr.io/wei-shaw/sub2api:0.2.24
```

**One-line install (Linux):**
```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/main/deploy/install.sh | sudo bash
```

Download the appropriate archive for your platform from the assets below.

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

name: Skill Recorder v0.9.3
body:
## Commit-pinned installation

Copy the complete command for your operating system into PowerShell (Windows) or Terminal (macOS/Ubuntu). Use the same command to install or update.

### Windows 11 x64 or ARM64

```powershell
$commit="0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a"; $env:SKILL_RECORDER_COMMIT=$commit; irm "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/$commit/install.ps1" | iex
```

Windows finishes installation without automatically opening the app. Finish any recording, choose **Quit** in all running Skill Recorder copies, then open **Skill Recorder (Source)** from the desktop or Start menu. Follow the completion notice if a manual launch command is needed.

### macOS or Ubuntu

Quit older running copies before updating, then run:

```sh
commit="0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a"; curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/$commit/install.sh" | SKILL_RECORDER_COMMIT="$commit" bash
```

For script inspection and hash verification before execution, use the [inspect-first instructions](https://github.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/blob/0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a/INSTALL.md#inspect-first-installation).

## Fixes

- **Recover fresh installations blocked by ONNX Runtime license-download failures.** If the pinned upstream legal-file URLs are unavailable, installation reports the failure and tries explicit version-pinned jsDelivr recovery URLs.
- **Preserve license verification.** Every recovered license and notice must match its existing reviewed SHA-256. Original source references and approved hashes are unchanged; mismatched content and HTML error pages are rejected.
- Retain recovery alternatives in `REMOTE-MATERIALS.json`, document recovery behavior, and add regression coverage for upstream failure, cache verification, recovery failure, and invalid content.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- This is a compatible patch release. Application dependency versions and existing compliance approvals are unchanged.
- Commands pinned to `63bbb50111713b02f3bc0ebbd5f354f4eb038f99` (0.9.2) retain the old behavior. Use the complete command above to obtain the fix; rerunning the old command will not update it.
- Recovery downloads require access to `cdn.jsdelivr.net` when the original upstream is unavailable. Verification is never bypassed if neither source is accessible.
- Recordings and application data remain in their existing locations.

## Source-only release

Skill Recorder 0.9.3 is published from commit [`0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a`](https://github.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/commit/0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a).

This release is **source-only**. No installers or portable binaries are attached. GitHub's generated archives contain the tagged repository source only, not dependencies or downloaded runtimes. Locally assembled source builds are not redistributable release binaries.

## Validation

- 49 local compliance and Windows dependency-installer tests passed.
- All six ONNX license/notice materials were retrieved through actual upstream failures and recovery downloads, matching their existing reviewed SHA-256 values and expected legal-text markers.
- Lockfile portability passed; every pre-existing compliance-policy entry was verified unchanged.
- Evaluation TypeScript checks passed.
- Exact release-commit CI passed on [Windows x64/ARM64](https://github.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/actions/runs/44610051734) and [macOS/Ubuntu](https://github.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/actions/runs/44610051477), covering commit-pinned source installation, license/compliance checks, tests, builds, BYOM runtime transport, and applicable packaging/architecture checks.

## Installer script SHA-256

These hashes were calculated from the exact release commit's Git blobs.

```text
766a2797cff1223266fb56b8c82bb77653dd42dcf3bcc7ffeefa6328bcd8c22d  install.ps1
bd8b5200a2c140c5a5ed9299d565ac72cee5420181774008977eaf75f210db1d  install.sh
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/compare/v0.9.2...v0.9.3

name: graphify 0.9.113
body:
- Change: **packaging** the minimum Python is now 3.11.5 (was 3.11), and soupsieve is pinned to 4.1.1 for every interpreter. soupsieve's patched releases require 3.11.5, so raising the floor clears the open soupsieve advisories (ReDoS and recursion/polynomial-DoS in the CSS selector parser, reached transitively through beautifulsoup4 in the optional `svg`/`all`/`pdf` extras). Installs on Python 3.11.0-3.11.4 keep resolving to 0.9.112; everyone on 3.11.5 and up is unaffected (#5301, thanks @TPAteeq).
- Fix: **ruby** methods of one class or module whose names differ only by a leading/trailing `_` or by case (`_read_attribute`/`read_attribute`, `_where!`/`where!`), including those in a `class << self`, get distinct node ids instead of one swallowing the other (#5292, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **lua** table-field functions whose names differ only by a leading/trailing `_` (`M._load`/`M.load`, `Runner:_start`/`Runner:start`) get distinct node ids; `M.f`/`M:f` still name one field (#5294, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **scala** members whose names differ only by a leading `_`, a `_=` setter suffix, or case (`_enter`/`enter`, `size`/`size_=`, `forEach`/`foreach`), including across a class and its companion object, get distinct node ids (#5296, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **elixir** defs whose names differ only by a leading/trailing `_`, a `!`/`?` suffix, or case (`_name`/`name`, `get`/`get!`, `__schema__`/`schema`) get distinct node ids, so a `get!` call no longer lands on `get` (#5298, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **rust** a prelude trait's type argument (`Celsius` in `impl From<Celsius>` or a `T: Into<Celsius>` bound) is read as a generic-argument reference instead of being mistaken for the trait itself, so it no longer emits a wrong `implements`/`inherits` edge (#5332, thanks @azeemshaik025).
- Fix: **go** a member call is kept when another package in the corpus names a sibling-file type: the colliding sourceless stub is moved to its own id instead of salting the real declaration and orphaning its method edges, which had dropped the call (#5304, thanks @Yi-111-a).
- Fix: **ruby** a method written inline after an access modifier (`private def validate`, `private_class_method def self.audit`) keeps its membership of the enclosing class instead of being emitted as a file-level function, so calls to it resolve to the method (#5310, thanks @Synvoya).
- Fix: **swift** a call that is the last operand of an operator expression (`base + bonus()`, `!isEmpty()`), which the grammar parses as the callee, is extracted instead of dropped (#5311, thanks @Synvoya).
- Fix: **kotlin** a call under a prefix operator (`!isReady()`, `-compute()`) is extracted instead of dropped, including stacked prefixes and `!obj.ready()` (#5312, thanks @Synvoya).
- Fix: **vbnet** a parameter with a default value is counted as Optional regardless of modifier order (`ByVal Optional x As Integer = 0`, `ByRef Optional ...`), so method arity and overload resolution are correct (#5320, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: **cpp** include identities are kept when the AST cache is on another drive than the source (a Windows cross-drive case where `os.path.relpath` raised and every file got an empty key), so declaration/definition folding still works; the normal same-drive path is unchanged (#5145, thanks @Ayushraj06-bit).
- Fix: **llm** label-generation retries keep a 512-token output floor, so the single-community recovery pass is no longer starved below the batch it is recovering from; an explicit `GRAPHIFY_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` still overrides (#2086, thanks @Synvoya).
- Fix: **ruby** an `include`/`prepend`/`extend` of a module written inside a `class << self` block emits its `mixes_in` edge, instead of being missed because only direct class-body statements were scanned (#5317, thanks @Synvoya).
- Fix: **python** a class with a parameterized base (`class C(Base[T])`, `class D(Mapping[str, int])`) emits the `inherits` edge to the base type and is walked for inherited-method calls, instead of being dropped and marked opaque; a nested generic argument, a call base, and `mod.Base[T]` are still not treated as parents (#5318, thanks @Synvoya).
- Fix: **tsconfig** a `tsconfig.json` `extends` and exact `compilerOptions.paths` mapping resolve to the real scanned config/file they name rather than a dangling stub; a non-corpus package extends, a wildcard path, and a circular extends fail closed (#5223, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: **cpp** an unreachable class forward declaration (one no include path reaches) no longer blocks the fold of a member's declaration into its out-of-line definition; genuinely ambiguous cases (a template or a second definition) still stay separate (#5337, thanks @winesoft-namjin-yun).
- Fix: **extract** an import that targets a header involved in an id collision is no longer unconditionally repointed to the header variant: the repoint is gated by the importing file's language family, so a Python `import foo` beside a colliding `foo.h`/`foo.py` keeps its edge to `foo.py` instead of being dropped as cross-language (#5328, thanks @sdivyanshu90).
- Fix: **serve** a query that is an exact node id resolves straight to that node instead of being out-ranked by a different node that shares its tokenized source path (#5343, thanks @Ayushraj06-bit).

The AST cache schema is bumped to 49; warm caches re-run the affected Ruby, Lua, Scala, Elixir, Rust, Swift, Kotlin, VB.NET, Python and TypeScript-config extractions.

body:
## [2.0.1] - 2026-11-19

### Added
- Add opt-in guided MCP setup directly in Step 0
- Detect Arabic (الفصل/الباب) chapter headings (#346)
- Detect Georgian (თავი) chapter headings (#325)

### Documentation
- Showcase Search & Read natively and elevate sponsor visibility
- Use openly licensed Pro Git instead of commercial book in examples
- Add Japanese README (#328)

### Fixed
- Clarify Search & Read onboarding UX and bare-search handling
- Prioritize open_access results, filter book topics, and compact display IDs
- Stop ranking unverified Crossref DOIs as open-access and defer output dir creation
- Align discovery and reader with libgen-mcp outline, cursor, and get_details schemas
- Don't end a chapter on a prose line matching a front-matter title (#352)
- Match outline titles wrapped onto three lines under a CHAPTER marker (#351)
- Keep a chapter opening that doubles as the running header (#336)
- Preserve table cell paragraph boundaries (#335)
- Count sentence-case Markdown chapter titles (#333)
- Drop Word paragraph revision ids in the fallback (#332)
- Propagate page count mismatch to page evidence (#331)
- Discard stale page evidence before output (#327)
- Accept whitespace around XML attribute equals (#323)
- Match letter-spaced outline chapter headings (#347)

### Miscellaneous
- Slim archives with export-ignore and compressed docs images (#324)
- Resolve v2.0.0 CodeQL alerts and exclude README.ja.md/uv.lock from archives

### Security
- Resolve remaining high CodeQL test alerts and annotate empty excepts

body:
# Cua Driver 0.55.0

## Summary

This release adds 2 features and includes 18 fixes.

## Features

- keep policy-forced extensions in isolated browser launches. ([#8101](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8101)) reported by @ComputelessComputer.
- download installer release assets from a mirror. ([#8136](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8136)) reported by @xiangxiangxiaomin-create.

## Fixes

- rebase Chromium screen extents only from a frame the size of the target window. ([#8167](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8167)) Thanks @CMGS.
- read Chrome's page content on macOS on the first read and while polling. ([#8133](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8133)) Thanks @abonneth.
- stop graceful-shutdown test racing the 100 ms budget. ([#8208](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8208))
- preserve Windows right-click modifiers. ([#8113](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8113)) Thanks @hqhq1025.
- emit Windows agent cursor hook updates. ([#8120](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8120)) Thanks @hqhq1025.
- put Hyprland browser bounds in Chromium's output space. ([#8108](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8108)) reported by @leonardsellem.
- match packaged-app frames to their app in capability manifests. ([#8129](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8129)) reported by @tornglass.
- accept a Windows click that closes or hides an unowned target window. ([#8166](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8166)) Thanks @CMGS.
- open the macOS permission guide at the left of the screen, clear of System Settings' list. ([#8219](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8219)) Thanks @CMGS.
- warn when pruning referenced release dirs. ([#8182](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8182)) Thanks @SssiiiSssii1.
- cover Hyprland cursor overlay focus isolation with a live test. ([#8222](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8222)) Thanks @LikelyLucid.
- rank macOS list_windows z_index by live stacking. ([#8158](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8158)) Thanks @S3yon; reported by @AceSilent.
- return at once from macOS bring_to_front when the exact window is already front. ([#8163](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8163)) Thanks @CMGS.
- the macOS permission guide names the app the driver runs in. ([#8123](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8123)) Thanks @CMGS.
- preserve physical pixels in the embedded Windows SDK. ([#8224](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8224)) Thanks @wszkxlllll.
- record background-unavailable refusals as refused and reject action truth that contradicts E2E oracles. ([#8105](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8105)) Thanks @hippoley; reported by @rsyuzyov.
- let callers perform an app's own macOS element actions. ([#7637](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7637)) Thanks @will-bogusz.
- admit background AX actions on Catalyst pop-up menu items. ([#8064](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/8064)) reported by @Ed-Key.

## Contributors

Thanks to @abonneth, @AceSilent, @CMGS, @ComputelessComputer, @Ed-Key, @hippoley, @hqhq1025, @leonardsellem, @LikelyLucid, @rsyuzyov, @S3yon, @SssiiiSssii1, @tornglass, @will-bogusz, @wszkxlllll, @xiangxiangxiaomin-create for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.
